events.description: One observed reading per (trip, stop, service date). Gzipped JSON Lines because the producer runs on a 512 MB machine that also serves the API, where a columnar writer cost more resident memory than the machine had spare.

predictions.description: A predicted terminal delay. Read back by the API.

snapshots.description: The raw GTFS-RT archive, one object per fetched payload, kept so parsing can be re-run over history. Opaque bytes: no record schema, and not an analytical dataset.
